zpa/network-platform-policies/np-policy-.operation_id: Np Policy Set Resource Delete Rule In Np Policy Set
zpa/network-platform-policies/np-policy-.operation_summary: Deletes the specified rule from the specified network policy set for the specified customer.

path_params.name: customerId
path_params.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

path_params.name: policySetId
path_params.description: The unique identifier of the policy set.

path_params.name: ruleId
path_params.description: The unique identifier of a rule in a policy.

query_params.name: microtenantId
query_params.description: The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

zpa/network-platform-policies/np-policy-.operation_id: Np Policy Set Resource Get Np Policy Rules By Page
zpa/network-platform-policies/np-policy-.operation_summary: Gets the paginated network policy rules for the specified policy type for the specified customer. Use search, page, and pagesize to filter and page the results, and includeInlineRules to control whether inline-created client state policy rules are included.

path_params.name: customerId
path_params.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

path_params.name: policyType
path_params.description: Type for differentiating NP policy types. Supported values: ZPE_VPN_ACCESS_POLICY

query_params.name: includeInlineRules
query_params.description: When true, inline-created client state policy rules (auto-generated by the firewall policy API with names matching '{customerId}_inline_policy_*') are included. When false (default), they are excluded.

query_params.name: microtenantId
query_params.description: The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

query_params.name: page
query_params.description: Specifies the page number.

query_params.name: pagesize
query_params.description: Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

query_params.name: search
query_params.description: The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

query_params.name: microtenantId
query_params.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.
